subject.title: fix(google-meet): force English UI when reusing existing Chrome tabs

question: May Google Meet join reload a reused matching tab to force English UI when that tab may already be in an active call?
rationale: Choosing between reload-in-place and preserving the user's active tab is a product and compatibility decision that source inspection and mocked tests cannot safely settle.

options.title: Preserve active tabs
options.body: Avoid unconditional navigation by preflighting safely or opening/selecting a separate English-pinned tab when the reused tab's state is ambiguous.

options.title: Accept reload-in-place
options.body: Keep the current behavior only after live proof shows acceptable outcomes for localized lobby tabs and already-active reused tabs.

recommendation.title: Preserve active tabs
recommendation.body: Avoid unconditional navigation by preflighting safely or opening/selecting a separate English-pinned tab when the reused tab's state is ambiguous.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the current Google Meet transport implementation on main and is the strongest available owner for the reused-tab lifecycle decision.
